field_of_view_deg: Fixed lens: 170.0 diagonal / 138.1 horizontal / 74.5 vertical; Pan-tilt lens: 49.6 diagonal / 42.7 horizontal / 22.8 vertical
features: fixed 170 wide-angle lens + 8mm pan/tilt telephoto lens
338 pan / 97 tilt mechanical range (360 pan / 120 tilt coverage)
color night vision with integrated spotlights

frigate.notes: Enable ONVIF/RTSP in the Tapo app (Camera Settings > Advanced) and create a Camera Account. Streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Dual-lens: the fixed and pan-tilt lenses expose separate streams. PoE (802.3af/at) supported for single-cable install. go2rtc alternative: TP-Link's proprietary protocol via go2rtc (tapo://<tapo-account-password>@{ip}) is often more stable than RTSP. Tapo exposes ONVIF PTZ on port 2020 (not 80).

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials. For local-only, use the ONVIF integration as an alternative.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Must enable ONVIF in the Tapo app.
